post.description: Sandbox only; requires recent current sign-in. Adds an unused alternate email or Indian mobile to the current account. Omitted request channel defaults to email for existing clients. No contact replacement or merging. Proof binds current actor, session, purpose and profile version. If-Match is the profile ETag. Same confirmation key/body returns original result after current authority checks; changed body conflicts. Purpose-specific email/mobile linking codes cannot be used for sign-in.
